longTitle.officialTitle: To clarify where court may be held for certain district courts in Texas and California.

enactingFormula.i: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representa­tives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Local Access to Courts Act” or “LACA”.

section.heading: ORGANIZATION OF TEXAS DISTRICT COURTS.
section.content: Section 124(b)(2) of title 28, United States Code, is amended, in the matter preceding paragraph (3), by inserting “and College Station” before the period at the end.

section.heading: ORGANIZATION OF CALIFORNIA DISTRICT COURTS.
section.content: Section 84(d) of title 28, United States Code, is amended by inserting “and El Centro” after “at San Diego”.
